metadata.title: Execute Test Cases
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Execute test cases with multi-type assertions (HTTP, MongoDB, SQS, S3, Coralogix, setup actions) and capture evidence for each step.

output.description: Test results with evidence JSON files for each step

prerequisites: Environment configured and AWS session active
specificActions: For each test case, initialize empty test context dictionary
For each step: identify assertion type, execute, capture evidence, compare results
Clear test context between test cases
bestPractices: Evidence MUST contain actual command output — NEVER summarize or reconstruct from memory
Save evidence JSON immediately after each step executes
Use curl.exe not curl on Windows
Pass JSON via temp files, not inline arguments
Use file:// prefix for AWS CLI JSON arguments
After SQS messages, wait 20-30s for consumer polling cycle before verification
All AWS CLI commands must include --profile and --region

assertionTypes.setup: External API calls (account holder creation). Store results in test context.
assertionTypes.http: HTTP response assertions (status, body, headers). Use curl.exe.
assertionTypes.s3: Object existence/content verification. Use AWS CLI.
assertionTypes.coralogix: Log query/error absence. Use DataPrime HTTP API. Skip if env has no Coralogix.

testContext.description: Dictionary maintained per test case for passing data between steps
testContext.populatedBy: Setup action steps that call external APIs
testContext.clearedBetween: Each test case starts with empty context

substeps.name: Identify assertion type
substeps.description: Determine what type of assertion each step requires
actions: Check step text against patterns in order: setup actions, HTTP, MongoDB, SQS, S3, Coralogix
Setup actions checked first (external API calls, account holder creation)

substeps.name: Execute step
substeps.description: Run the assertion based on type
actions: Setup: call external API, extract IDs, store in test context
SQS: use AWS CLI with --profile and --region
S3: use AWS CLI with --profile and --region
Coralogix: query via DataPrime HTTP API

substeps.name: Capture evidence
actions: Include: timestamp, testCaseId, stepNumber, stepType, assertionType, input, output, assertion (expected, actual, passed)

substeps.name: Compare results for ValidateStep
actions: For ValidateStep: compare actual result against expected
Mark PASS if assertion matches, FAIL with details if not

substeps.name: Record and continue
substeps.description: Store result and move to next step/test case
actions: Continue to next step or next test case
Clear test context between test cases

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
actions: Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: For each TC: init context → for each step: identify type → execute → capture evidence → compare → record → next TC

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Parsed test cases and environment config
